data.name: Tech-Curious Spectator
data.role: General audience viewer with an interest in emerging technology
data.informationNeed: The tech-curious spectator wants engaging and visually clear footage of a humanoid robot race that emphasizes motion, successes, failures, and unusual moments that make the technology feel tangible and futuristic. They seek brief, accessible context to understand why the task is challenging, but are not interested in technical depth or academic analysis, prioritizing entertainment and a sense of real-world progress over explanation.

data.name: U.S. Coast Guard Marine Inspector, Sector Los Angeles–Long Beach
data.role: U.S. Coast Guard Marine Inspector, Sector Los Angeles–Long Beach
data.informationNeed: I am a marine inspector at U.S. Coast Guard Sector Los Angeles–Long Beach, working out of the prevention department that covers the largest container port complex in the country. My day-to-day involves Port State Control boardings on foreign-flagged vessels, verifying cargo securing manuals, lashing arrangements, stability documentation, and crew certifications against SOLAS and CFR requirements. When a casualty happens in our captain-of-the-port zone I stand up or join a Unified Command alongside the local fire department, the port, the Army Corps of Engineers, and the responsible party, and I work the investigation that eventually gets reported up the chain. My goal is to keep foreign tonnage moving safely through the San Pedro Bay while making sure that when something does go wrong, we understand why and the lessons get pushed back out to industry.

data.name: LoanDepot Park Guest Services Usher
data.informationNeed: I work as a guest services usher at loanDepot Park, the home of the Miami Marlins, during MLB home stands. My zone is one of the lower-level corner sections behind the dugouts where I check tickets at the aisle, direct families to their seats, help guests find concessions, and field complaints from fans about everything from spilled beer to obstructed views. I report to a section supervisor who in turn answers to the head of guest services, and on busy nights we coordinate with stadium security to handle any escalations. The job is part-time, mostly evenings and weekends, and I've come to know the regulars in my section by face.
